(nga )༄༅/ /rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti'i lugs kyi rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti'i lugs kyi rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// gser chos// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra yo gi nī sā dha na/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// shes rab// stong pa nyid dang thabs snying rje'i bdag nyid can/ gsang ba gsum rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor gsum// khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid/ du nyon mongs pa bsregs pas// bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ dpal// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs 'dud// bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ in+d+ra bhū ti lta bu// rtog pa gcig pa'i spyod yul te// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma

'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ phyi rabs kyi don du// mdor bsdus bdag gis bshad par bya// ༈ /de la dang po rten gyi gang zag sngags pas thog mar bya ba'i rim pa re zhig bla ma dang*/ sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i dkon mchog rnams la mngon par gus pa'i yid kyis gzhan don byang chub kyi sems brtan par bzung ste rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos smin grol gyi dbang bskur yang dag par thob nas chos thams cad blo bur ba ma yin te gdod ma nas rnam par dag pa ngo bo nyid kyis 'od gsal ba'i rang bzhin spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bral ba'i stong pa nyid yin yang*/ rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa sgrub pa mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ ༈ / gnyis pa gnas bstan pa dur khrod dam shing gcig la ma ma mo'i gnas la sogs pa nyams dga' zhing yid dang rjes su mthun pa de la sogs pa'i dben pa'i gnas su stan 'jam po la rnal 'byor gyi rol pas rab tu bsngags pa'i gnas nub phyogs o rgyan/ su kha bltas te 'dug nas/ ༈ / gsum pa cho ga nyams su blang ba'i rim pa bstan pa de'i rjes la rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin gyis lus dang ngag dang yid dag pa'i phyir lha rdzas kyi btung ba sbrang chang ngam/ bu ram chang ngam/ bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ nas kyi chang sbyar ba las byung ba ste/ rnam pa gsum po ji ltar rnyed pa bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa thod pa sogs mchod yon gyi snod du bzhag ste/ yi ge gsum mngon par bzlas nas gnas gsum du reg cing lce la bzhag btung de'i rjes la khrus bya gsungs/ ba des lag pa g.yas kyis g.yon pa nas brtsams te/ yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag la gtor/ de nas lhag pa phan tshun gnyis te lus la byug thams cad la 'bru gsum bzlas pa'i chang gis sngags kyi khrus bya'o// de nyid kyis mchod pa'i rdzas dang gtor ma rnams la gtor nas sngags sum+bhas bsang bar bya'o// lag pa byin gyis brlab pa ni de'i rjes la/

oṃ bam̐ dmar po mthil du ham̐ yam̐ sngon po mthe'u chung*/ hriṃ mam̐/ dkar po srin lag hriṃ hriṃ/ ser po gung mo/ huṃ hūm̐/ dud ka mdzub mo/ phaṭa phaṭa ljang gu mthe bong*/ ces bya ba'i sngags kyi yi ge 'di rnams kyis lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams yang dag par sbyangs te lus ngag yid gsum gyi dag pa brjod par bya'o// de'ang dbyings kyi dag pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ lus ngag yid gsum dag pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha sarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ ye shes kyi dag pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ yo ga shud+dha sarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ 'di yan chad lha bskyed pa'i sngon du bya ba'o/ /de ltar dag pa gsum gyi sngags kyis las nyon dag nas rang gi lus khams gsum dang sa gsum dang lus ngag yid gsum rnam par dag pa'i rten chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang phyi dkar la nang dmar ba nyid du bsams nas/ skad cig gis brten pa lha/ lte ba'i dkyil thad ka chos 'byung gi slad du nang gi rdo rje phag mo oṃ gi rang bzhin du gnas pa de nas phyag gi rnam par gsal ba yin gyi/ sa bon sogs las bskyed pa min gsungs/ du rdo rje phag mo phyag gnyis ma gri gug shes rab brda/ dang*/ ka pā la dang thabs/ kha zung 'jug ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ snying rje dang bde ba'i brda ḍā ma ru dang dril bus mtshan pa/ dbu skra grol chags pa'i brda/ ba gcer mo nyon mongs pas ma gos pa'i brda/ spyan gsum ma ste/ na tshod gsar bcu drug lon pa lta bu gdul bya myur du 'dul ba'o/ pas mdzes pa la// phyag rgya rigs lnga yongs su dag pa'i brda/ lnga yis rnam par brgyan// sangs rgyas lnga rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyus pa'i thod pa kha dog lnga bas dbu gnyis ka brgyan pa de'i steng na sangs rgyas rigs lngas mtshan pa'am/ yang na thod pa lnga po de rigs lnga'i ngo bor bsgom pa'o//

yi cod pan can/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ni// pad nyi me yi dbus na bzhugs/ pa ste 'og tu chos 'byung*/ de'i steng pad+ma de'i steng ngo*// de'i steng nyi ma me ltar 'bar ba/ /dza ba me tog dmar po zhig go /bde ba chen po'i ro la mchog tu chags pa'i brda/ bin+dhu ra yi mdog /de 'dra'i gzugs 'chang lha mo ni/ bla mas ji ltar bstan pa/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bsgom// de yi g.yas na phag gdong ste/ ser ba dang dmar ba gnyis las 'di dmar ba'i lugs yin/ de'ang dmar ba spu med pa mche ba gtsigs pa ste zhal phyag la gtsang dme med pa don dam pa'i bden pa la dge mi dge thams cad la rnam rtog med pa'i brda/ /de bzhin g.yon pa khro mo'i zhal// kun rdzob dang ni don dam gnyis// zhal ni gnyis su rab tu brjod// bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ lha sgrub pa'i sgom pa dang gong gi sngags sa bon yang rang rgyas su bsgom/ dbu rgyan yang rang chas su ste rigs bdag la mi bskyod pa dbus su'o// bdag don du byin rlabs kyi rgyun bsgom pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*/ gzhon nu byin rlabs te byin rlabs kyi rgyun bsgom du gzhug pa'o/ /rim pa rgyas par shes par bya// de yi pad+ma dmar ba 'i nang gnas pa'i/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi/ /'khor lo don kun grub pa ste dngos grub rnam pa gnyis gsol ba// yon tan gsum rgyan mtshan ma ni/ rnam thar gsum gyi brda chos 'byung nang du sngags phreng gsum bsgom/ de'ang 'khor lo'i tshul lo/ /'od chen kha dog shin tu dmar/ oṃ gsum ma yid kyis brjod pas chos 'byung sngags kyi 'od dang*/ sum mdor me bsgoms te chu'i 'od gyen la byung ba ltar/ dpe gcig tu 'bar zhes snang*/ /sngags kyi yi ges te baṃ yig la rim pa bdun gyis bskor te legs par gang*/ chos 'byung la brten nas 'khor lo de myur bas

rdza mkhan 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor/ 'og sgo sgom ba'i dus su/ /srin po'i zhal ni legs bsdams nas// me ni kun nas sbar bar bya// g.yung drung g.yon du 'khyil pa 'khor ba yi// dkyil 'khor phag gdong smin mtshams mtho gang gi mthong bar nye bar blta// phyag rgya bde stong gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis// 'jig rten gsum du grags pa'i thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad du ma zad sangs rgyas kyang 'grub par 'gyur bas de yang sgrub par byed/ tha mal gyis rnam rtog skad cig tsam yang mi snang ba'i rnam pa'i rnal 'byor dag / zab mo'i rnal 'byor las 'grub par 'gyur gyis gzhan du min no/ dus gcig gam gnyis sam res mos su// ༈ /bzhi pa sngags dag par bya ba'i phyir btu bar bstan pa ni/ de nas slob dpon gyis sngags kyi gnang ba sbyin dgos pas gzhan yang bshad bya ba// gsang sngags btu ba'i cho ga mchog / bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i don gyi yan lag sngags dag par bya phyir btu ba'i thabs kyi cho ga la phyi chos 'byung*/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum nyams dga' bar/ bri bar bya ste/ /rdo rje bde ba dang*/ ā ral+li stong pa ste bde stong thabs shes zung 'jug las chos thams cad byung*/ bas na/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes bshad cing*/ ming gi rnam grangs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga zhes kyang ngo*/ de lta bu'i chos 'byung gi dbus su ā li kā li dbye bas der// sde tshan brgyad ni rim pas bri/ bar bya ste/ bang rim bdun du re'u mig gi nges pa/ /gzugs 1me 2mda' 5dang thub 7pa dang*// bug 9pa drag po 11'dod pa 13yis// rim pa man ngag brdas bshad pa ji bzhin du// re mig bzhi bcu rtsa dgu rnams su dgod par bya 'o/ de la gang dgod na/ /dang por a yig nas brtsams te// yi ge ha yi mthar thug bar/ k+ṣa spangs pa'i ā li kā li bzhin bcu rtsa dgu /g.yon skor gyi ni sbyor ba yis/ bkod nas/ btu tshul dngos ni/

/sdom pa rgya mtshor te 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin/ te de'ang re'u mig gi nang du bkod pa'i/ /tha 'i yi ge'i steng 'khor lo dang zhib tu sbyar/ ma ni o yig steng sum 'gyur o o o zhes byas nas ni/ /de la sgra ste nā da dang thig las rnam par brgyan/ pas oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes grub bo// de bzhin du/ /bha 'thug steng sa dang tsha steng pa yig /spyi bor ta log steng ma ra sa brgyan/ pas sarba /tsa sa'i dbus nas ba blangs nas su// de bzhin ḍa yi 'og ma u sa brgyan// sha log steng ma dha ra sha steng da bskyon// de bzhin yang dag sbyor ba'o/ /bud+dha l̥ thung 'og gi yi ge ḍa la// nya yi 'og ma a 'as rnam par brgyan// sa steng ka ta log 'og ma i sa sbyar// pha steng na tha log 'og gi ī sa dbye/ ḍā ki nī/ /ha da ṭa yig dbus ya yig la// na log steng na a gnas par brgyan/ ye ṣa yi 'og na gnas pa bzung*// bha 'thug 'og ma dza na log gi /'og ma ra yis ni gdan du bya/ /badz+ra/ /ha steng gnas pa'i yi ge wa nyid// ra steng ṇa ra yi steng ma ṇa sbyar/ dpe la lar ṭa log ces snang ba ta yig la ngos bzung ba'i bkod lugs kyang 'dug /ta log steng na gnas pa ra yis// spyi bor sbyar ba yongs su grags// pha steng na tha log 'og ma ī yis// rnam par sbyar ba brjod pa yin/ bar+ṇaṇa nī nya yi steng ya na na log steng*/ e sbyar ba'i man ngag gis shes bya/ ye tsa sa'i dbus nas ba blangs nas ni// bha 'thug 'og ma dza na log gi /'og ma ra yi ni gdan du bya/ badz+ra/ /de bzhin tsha yig steng nas ba blangs// ta yi steng na gnas pa ai sa brgyan// tha steng o na log 'og ma ra ra brgyan// de bzhin pa yi 'og gnas tsa yig /dha ba'i dbus gnas yi ge na la// tha log 'og ma i sa rnam par brgyan/ /be ro tsa nī nya la'i dbus gnas yi ge ya la// na log steng ma a sa rnam par brgyan/ /ye /sa ya'i dbus gnas yi ge

ha la// rā ring 'og ma ū sa dbye bar bya// thig le nā da yang dag ldan// de yang bum 'gyur bya ba yin/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ /na yi 'og nas pha ra 'og ṭa dbye// de yang sum 'gyur bya ba'o/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa /ka yi 'og sa nas ṣa 'og ba zhon// nya 'og ā gnas pas dbye bar bya// ma wa'i dbus gnas ha yang dag ldan// dza 'thug rgyab kyi dbyangs kyi ās brgyan/ swā hā zhes grub bo/ /de ltar /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni// gsang sngags btu ba'ang lhag chad med par shes par bya/ de ltar btus pa'i dges ba /glegs bam las ni rang shes su/ bzung ba'i sngags/ zlo lhur byed pa'i sngags pas/ yang dag pa'i gdams ngag med pas sngags btu bya dang blang ba spang ba yis/ nam yang mi 'grub/ des na sngags btu ba'i cho gas blangs pas grub kyi gzhan du na/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni// dngos grub rnams su mi 'gyur nyid/ de rten 'brel gyi che ba'o// ༈ /lnga pa'i phyi rol mchod pa dang tshes bcu'i mchod pa thun mong du bstan pa/ de nas rang gzhan gnyis kyi don du thun mong pa khyad par gyi cho ga yang dag bshad pas bya// mchod pa'i ye shes rdo rje rang gzhan gnyis la don kun 'byung ba/ /yar mar gnyis kyi tshes bcu'i dus su babs pa na/ spyir yo byad kyi mchod pa byed pa la dus med/ yo byad bsham pa ni/ /mchod pa lnga dang yang dag ldan// bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba dang*// phyi dang gsang ba yang dag ldan/ mchod pa'i rten bsham pa ni/ /dri med snod ni yang dag par// gur gum sogs kyis byugs nas su/ dri bzang*/ /bzang po'i btung ba chang gis byugs pa/ yang dag ldan// sin+dhur phye ma dar chag la gtsags pa la// gser smyug gi ni sbyor ba yis// mkhas pas phyi chos 'byung gru gsum/ e wam̐ rnam par bri/ ba'i dbus su bam̐ yi/ /dbus su gsang sngags rgyal po oṃ gsum ma ni// bstan bcos kyi ni rim pas te sngags btu ba bzhin g.yon skor du

bri/ mi 'gyur ba dga' ba 'khyil pa/ /g.yung drung dge ba'i phyag rgya dngos grub ster ba ni// 'khor lo yi ni logs su ste grwa zur bzhi la dgod/ de'i mtha' skor du /me tog dmar po gtso bor gyur pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ ste chu dang de bzhin thang las skyes/ la sogs nyer spyod dang*/ /sgron ma ste sha lnga dang tsā ru ste lha bshos dang dam tshig gi rdzas bdud rtsi lnga rnams tshogs pa gces/ ༈ /drug pa gzhon nu ma'i ston mo gsang bar gdams pa dang bcas pa/ /de bzhin gzhon nu ma dag mchod/ pa ni 'jam dpal la ri bo rtse lngar khye'u lo brgyad lon pa la ston mo byed pa ltar bu mo lo bcu drug lon pa rnal 'byor mar byin gyis brlabs la ston mo bya ba'i/ /mchod pa'i las ni khyad par du/ lha dngos mchod pa'i phan yon 'byung bas the tshom med par/ /gdon mi za bar mchod par bya ba ste/ de'i dus su skyod pa'i ltar bya ba ni sgrub po bdag nyid // skra grol gcer bur byas pa yis// sngar bshad phyogs su ste gong nas 'byung ba ltar nub phyogs o rgyan du kha bltas nas// mnyam par bzhag pas mchod pa yi// dus su lha dang mchod pa sngags rin po che thams cad shin tu gsang ste bya/ ma gsang rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don la bar chad 'jug pa'i gegs ni 'byung 'gyur te// de bzhin du yang dngos grub skye ba 'di la mi thob pas nyams/ gzhan yang ma gsang ba'i skyon nad kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pa'ang*// dam tshig nyams te gsang ba bsgrags pa 'ba' zhig las 'byung bar 'gyur/ bas na/ /srog ni yongs su gtong ba'am// 'chi ba dang ni 'phrad kyang sla// gal te dngos grub mchog 'dod na// dam tshig rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /ste gsang ba kho na la 'bad par bya'o// ༈ /bdun 'dus thams cad kyi spyod pa bstan pa/ /'gro kun g.yon las byung ba ste/ kun rdzob tu g.yon gyi brdas phud med do/ /'jig rten gsum po brtan dang g.yo/

ba thams cad don dam du g.yon gyi 'od gsal stong pa las byung ba'o/ /de'i brdar rtag tu rnal 'byor pas g.yon pa 'i kun tu spyod pa sa spyad/ par bya ste/ ji ltar na/ /rkang pa g.yon pa sngon du dor// mchod pa lag pa g.yon gyis bya// g.yon gyis gzhan la mchod pa sogs bstab cing rang gis kyang bza' bar bya 'o/ grogs phyag rgya rgyal rigs sogs/ /rigs lngar kun tu spyod pas na/ thams cad rigs gcig tu ni brtag par bya/ ste phag mor mos par bya/ gzhan lang spyod pa'i khyad par bza' dang bza' min de bzhin btung*// gtsang rme ra 'dzin pa'i 'du shes dor nas rang ngo mi shes pa'i sar byin la ngo tsha spang bar bya/ tha ma la kun rtog kun las nges grol bas/ yod med rtag chad gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs// rnal 'byor gsang mtha' bde mchog drwa ba'i sdom pa yi/

sngags pas spyod pa ji ltar byed na rnal 'byor pas ri dwags kyi rgyal po seng ge bzhin du 'jigs pa med par spyod/ par bya'o// ༈ /dgu pa sngags kyi che ba bstan pa/ gru gsum sngags kyis gang ba'i gsang sngags rnal 'byor ma ste lha mo dngos/ rje btsun ma'i sngags la khyad par du yid ches skyed pa'i phyir dngos grub ye shes lnga nang sku lngar ldan pas rnal 'byor ma yang gsang sngags dngos/ de'i phyir gal te go 'phang mchog 'dod na/ sngags dang lha de dag tha dad mi bya ste/ the tshom mi za bar bsam pa rtse gcig pas gang dag gang gis sngags bzlas na ni// mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ ba ste 'dod pa'i dngos grub de dang de yi ngo bor 'gyur/ gsang sngags gcig yin yang yid ches pa las dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i dpe zas la sogs pa dngos grub tu 'byung*// ba ni/ /dper na zas gos sogs sna tshogs pa'i 'dod chu'i nor 'bebs pa yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin no/ de'ang*/ /sems ni bsam gtan dang rjes su mthun pa'i ting nge 'dzin lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor gyis// gang zhig gsang sngags kyi rgyal po'i bzlas brjod la goms par byed na ni/ 'jig rten grags pa'i bsod nams chung ba'i mi yis kyang*/ bzlas sgom gnyis kyis dngos grub thams cad myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med/ de dpal he ru kas gsungs pas so// ༈ /bcu pa de thob pa'i thabs nang bla ma mnyes pa las byung ba bstan pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// bla ma de ni dge 'dun te/ dkon mchog gsum tha mi dad du blta'o// khyad par tshe gcig gis sgrub pa po la mchog gi dngos grub stsol bas/ /bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje can/ te rdo rje 'chang dang tha mi dad pas na/ dngos grub thams cad bla ma mnyes pa las 'byung gi gzhan du nas yang mi 'byung bas/ /'dir ni bla ma khon dngos grub kyi rgyu yin no/ /des na 'bras bu dman pa la yid mi chags par

sangs rgyas go 'phang 'dod pa yis// de phyir bla ma mnyes par bya/ ba kho na shin tu gces so// ༈ /zhar byung dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs kyi mtshan nyid / dgongs pa bla na med pa nyid/ /de rnal 'byor rgyud man chad la med pa'i bla med kyi khyad chos tshe gcig gis rdo rje 'chang 'grub par byed pa'o// man ngag gi 'byung gnas bstan pa dpal ldan u rgyan gnas kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang mdzod chen po nas byung zhing grub pa'i slob dpon chen po rnams las rim par brgyud pa bar ma chad pa 'o// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gdams ngag gsang ba in+d+ra bhū ti la sogs pa' ི snyan nas snyan dang zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i rjes su gnang ba'i gzhung lugs slob dpon chen po dpal o rgyan gyi mi dbang in+d+ra bhū tis mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal na len+d+ra pa dang*/ lo tsā ba dge slong pra dz+nyā kī rtis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga bklags chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so// pad+ma mi ro nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng*// skye rgu'i skyabs gcig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// bden gnyis don mtshon zhal zung ldan pa yis// 'gro kun 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol// 'dir 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang dang rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pas phag mo zhal gnyis ma bsgom pa'i tshul la/ skyabs sems yig brgya tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bya/ swa bhā ba sogs brjod/ gnas lugs kyi don la blo cung zad bzhag stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum pa phyi rol thams cad me ri 'bar ba/ de'i lte bar pad+ma mi ro nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gnyis kyi g.yas don dam pa mtshon pa'i phag zhal nag po/

g.yon kun rdzob mtshon pa'i khro mo'i zhal dmar po cung zad thur du gzigs pa/ zhal gnyis ka'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra sil bu thur du grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon pa na thabs mtshon pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ sku gcer bu la rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i brla la g.yas pa'i sor mo gtad pa'i phyed krung gi tshul/ zhabs g.yon pa'i mthil nyi ma'i steng du btsugs pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i lte bar oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo zhes sogs kyi go cha dkyus bzhin/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya phaiṃ gyi sgra dang bcas pas ye shes pa spyan drang*/ oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas bdag gi lus la bstim/ yang 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang phaiṃ zhes brjod pas dbang skur gyi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs spyan drang*/ bdag la dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur te lus gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bo'i steng du mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas phyi mchod da nga*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ de nas spro na rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin rdzogs rim kyang bsgom/ bzlas pa ni snying gar nyi ma'i steng du bam̐ yig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer spro bsdu dang*/ lha'i rnam pa la dmigs pa gtad pa'i sgo nas oṃ gsum ma ci nus bzla/ mthar rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

zhes dang yig brgya brjod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du sogs kyis bsngo ba bya/ byin rlabs bya ba'i tshul ni/ tshes bcu gnyis gang yang rung ba la/ gnas dben par rdul tshon dmar pos chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs bris/ rtsibs drug la rdul tshon dkar pos shar rtsibs nas bzung ste/ oṃ bam̐/ ham̐ yom̐/ hrīṃ mom̐/ hriṃ hriṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa rnams yig mgo phyir bstan la bri/ de'i dbus su bam̐ bri/ de'i khar mañji'i steng ka pā la'i nang du chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar bas bkang ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa bzhag de'i steng maṇ+ḍal gyi steng sin+dhū ra'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs de'i dbus su bam̐ gyi mthar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bris la/ zur bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba bris pa re bzhag de'i mdun nam khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ gtor ma gnyis sam gsum bsham/ bum pa dri bzang dung chos gzungs rdor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'og tu slob mar dgos pa'i mig dar me tog sogs dang*/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdor dril bzhag de nas slob dpon gdan la 'dug la skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar mngon rtogs dkyus bzhin bsgom/ de nas rang gi mdun gyi nang mchod dang*/ sin+dhū ra'i 'og thod chang la dmigs te/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bdud rtsi byin rlabs rgyas pa'am bsdu na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin brlab/ sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor dang rdul tshon la dmigs te/ sum+bhas bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum nyis brtsegs mtha' me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i dbus su rnal 'byor ma mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed/ de la go cha dgod/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang lha spyan drangs nas dbang bskur zhing mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa rnams mngon rtogs bzhin dang*/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs la/

oṃ badz+ra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra'i mthar ar+ghaṃ sogs so sor sbyar nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod byin rlabs dran par byas la/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yi dam gyi lha rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i zhal du= /chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rigs drug gi sems can la sbyin/ yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bsdu na/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ de nas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa dkyus bzhin bskyed la/ de'i dbus su ji skad bshad pa'i gdan gyi steng du bam̐ las rdo rje phag mo zhal gnyis ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed/ de la phyi mchod nang mchod dang*/ bstod pas bstod pa gzungs thag nas bzung la oṃ gsum ma bzlas pas/ sngags kyi 'od zer bdag gi zhal nas 'phros te gzungs thag la 'khril nas bum nang du song bas rnal 'byor ma'i sku la phog pas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ste bum pa'i nang du bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis mer gang bar bsam zhing oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa bzlas/ slar mchod bstod byas la/ dung chos kyi chu bum nang du blugs pas rje btsun ma 'od du zhu ba bdud rtsi'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la oṃ gsum ma'i mthar i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dang po rnal 'byor ma la phul/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod dang nang mchod dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

de nas gtor ma gzhan la dmigs nas chos skyong gtor ma bsngo ba rim pa bzhin du bya ba'am/ yang na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dkyus bzhin gyis chog 'dir slob dpon gyis bdag 'jug len pa ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang 'gal ba med/ spro na maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab nas bzung*/ gtso bos ji ltar gyi bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin blang*/ de nas slob ma bos la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes pa nas/ byin rlabs kyi bka' zhu snyam pa'i bsam pa sems bskyed du gzhug gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni rje btsun sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i dmar mo skor gsum gyi nang nas in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs yin/ de la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag mdun bum gsum gyi rim pa rnams bsgrubs zin/ de khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba la byin rlabs kyi bka' zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad la/ bla ma yi dam gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa 'di gsung bar zhu/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor mas// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lan gsum/ de nas sdig pa bshags pa nas skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa'i dmigs pa brda sprad la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs kyi rgyun bshags lan gsum/ da khyed rang rnams thugs 'dun pa ma yengs par 'di la snyan gtad par zhu/ rtog pas g.yogs pa'i sems kyis ni// legs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir bzlog ltar// dad pa'i chu yis bkrus pa'i sems// phan pa'i sems kyis 'dir 'jug bya// dad pa med pa'i sems can la// dkar po'i chos rnams mi 'byung ste// ji ltar sa bon tshig pa la// myu gu sngon po skye mi srid// ces gsungs te de'i don yang rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs la/

bla ma dang lha la dad gus drag po bskyed cing chos nyams su len pa'i spro ba dung pa re skyed par zhu/ ku shas bum chu nas gtor la/ sum+bha brjod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis mig dar bcing*/ lag pa g.yon pas khu tshur gyi se gol phyogs bzhir gtogs shing sum+bha brjod pas bsrung ba bya/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la dbus nas dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbarjod/ gu gul gyi dud pas bskor zhing*/ ye shes dbab pa'i slad du thugs 'dun 'di bzhin gnang bar zhu/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus snang stong sgyu ma lta bu de yang mi dmigs par bsgom/ de'i ngang las skad cig gis chos 'byung nyis brtsegs me ri 'bar ba'i lte bar pad+ma mi ro nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams rje btsun ma sku mdog dmar mo zhes pa nas/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed pa'am/ lte bar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi dbus su bam̐ yig sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ zur bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa gsal gdab/ bam̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas g.yas ro ma nas yar song*/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim/ spyi gtsug gi haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dbu ma nas byung nas lte bar 'bab pa la thugs gtad pas drod skyes/ yang lte ba nas 'od zer 'phros/ g.yas ro ma nas song ste zhal g.yas pa'i phag gdong gi g.yung drung 'khyil ba la phog ste/ de g.yon du myur du 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad par zhu/ mi rtog pa skyes/ yang lte ba'i 'khor lo de gsang gnas su phab ste myur du 'khor ba la sems gtad par zhu/ bde ba skyes/ de ltar na bde ba mi rtog pa'i ngang la cung zhig 'jog par zhu/

dril bu'i sgra chung ba dkrol la/ oṃ gsum ma brjod/ de ltar ye shes phab pas lus kyi ba spu ldang ba la sogs pa'am ngag tu sngags brjod pa'am sems la mi rtog pa skye ba la sogs pa ci rigs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye shes brtan par gyur cig ces brjod/ sngar gyi me tog de nyid rje btsun mar phul la oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥbarjod du 'jug slar me tog sngags kyi phreng bar bsgyur te spyi gtsug tu bzhag la/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa badz+ra sogs brjod/ rnal 'byor ma dpal deng khyod kyi// zhes sogs dang bcas pas mig dar bsal la lha ngo bstan/ de yan chad kyis 'jug pa'i chos song*/ dngos gzhi'i slad du maṇ+ḍal/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol gdab lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams thugs 'dun 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ rje btsun ma'i mdun ngos su dbang stegs chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi lte bar pad nyi'i steng du khyed rang rje btsun mar gsal ba'i spyi bor gdugs/ g.yas g.yon du rgyal mtshan ba dan/ khor yug tu mchod pa'i phreng bas bskor ba dang bcas te bzhugs pa'i mos pa gnang*/ slob dpon rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ phyag tu bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ spyi bor bum pa bzhag la/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ gi bar brjod/ bum chu sbyin/ de ltar dbang bskur bas lus thams cad byang chub sems kyi rgyus gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa'i mos pa gnang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las sngags kyi phreng ba chad/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi khar zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la g.yon skor du 'khod par bsams la/ 'di'i rjes zlos gsung bar zhu/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum/ slob mas me tog 'thor zhing*/

bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'di la sogs bya/ des bum pa'i dbang thob pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ de nas sin+dhū ra'i thod chang blangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing slob ma la bdud rtsir sbyin/ slob dpon gyis oṃ gsum ma bzlas/ des gsang dbang thob pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ de nas yang sin+dhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi sngags phreng rnams slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon pas blangs la slob ma'i srin lag g.yon par bskus la rang rang gi lte bar byug tu gzhug chung ba yin/ slob dpon gyis oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig bzla/ de nas sin+dhū ra'i sngags phreng rnams lte bar thim par mos pa mdzod/ yang dga' ba 'khyil ba'i sin+dhū ra rnams blangs la oṃ gsum ma bzla zhing dpral bar byugs pas dga' ba 'khyil pa rnams smin mtshams su thim par bsam/ yang 'og gi go cha'i rdul tshon rnams blangs la/ go cha'i sngags rnams bzla zhing spyi gtsug tu byug go cha'i sngags rnams spyi gtsug tu thim par mos pa mdzod/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ dbang bzhi pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ dngos po med pa'i chos nyid chos// nam mkha' lta bur dri med par// stong pa'i ye shes rdo rje yis// stong pa nyid du rnam par bsgom// zhes gsungs te de'i don ye gdod ma nas dngos po dang dngos po med pa la sogs pa'i spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu skye 'gag mtha' dbus dang bral ba de'i ngang du cung zhig 'jog par zhu/ de ni dbang bzhi pa yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ de'i gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa srung sdom bgyi snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal sogs 'dra/ slar slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa bya/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/

yig brgya brjod cing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ bsngo ba dang shis brjod kyi phreng bas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// de ltar in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs dang byin rlabs kyi cho ga zung du 'brel ba 'di ni phyag len gyi bka' mi nub par bya ba'i phyir rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang phag mo'i las bcu'i nang gi byin rlabs kyi cho ga gzhir bzhag la/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po yab sras kyi gsung gi zin thos brgyan te dge slong ngag dbang chos grags kyis chu mo bya'i lo zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyin spu dkar bla brang rdzong du bris pa'i yi ge pa ni chos grags bzang po'o// 'dis kyang bstan pa dar zhing skye rgu rnams bde legs su gyur cig brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje phag mo/ grub chen lwa ba pa/ rgyal chen in+d+ra bhū ti/ lcam lak+ṣ+mīṃ ka ra/ bram ze bir+wa pa/ sha ba ri pa/ grub chen mai tri pa/ rgya gar phyag na/ bal po bha ren+d+ra ru tsi/ bal po ye shes rdo rje/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje khu dbon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ grub chen brag phug pa/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rgyal/ gu shrī ba nam mkha' bzang po/ nyi lde ba ngag dbang grags pa/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang*/ rje btsun rdo rings pa chen po/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje bla ma dam pa dbang phyug rab brtan/ des bdag la'o// ༈ /in+d+ra mkha' spyod kyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// dpal mo mkha' spyod zhing gtso rnal 'byor ma// dpal ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug lwa ba par// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// rgyal rigs grub brnyes in+d+ra bhū ti'i zhabs// rgyal yum gtso bo la k+ṣ+mīṃ ka ra dang*// bram ze'i rigs 'khrungs grub chen bir+wa par// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// brtul zhugs grub po dpal ldan sha wa ri// de sras thu bo rje btsun mai tri pa// paṇa grub rgya gar phyag na rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// bal po'i paṇa chen bha ren+d+ra ru tsi// mkhas grub dam pa dz+nyā na badz+ra'i zhabs// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag bla chen brtse ba cher// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// 'ja' lus mkha' spyod brnyes pa bsod nams rtse// rdo rje 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs// 'jam dbyangs bla ma sa skya paṇ+ḍi tar// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rje// de sras thu bo zhang ston dkon mchog dpal// rtse gcig sgrub pa mthar phyin brag phug par// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// srid gsum 'gran bral bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis pa// kwan ting gu shrī nam mkha' bzang po la// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// mkhas mchog ngag dbang grags pa nyi lde ba// mthu stobs dbang phyug rgya gar shes rab mtshan// bdag chen chos rje blo gros rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// mkhas grub dbang po rje btsun rdo rings pa// snyan brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po tshar pa rje// thugs sras snyan brgyud 'dzin pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod dngos grub stsol// khyab bdag bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan dang*// kun mkhyen mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan dpal// rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so=
